pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-07.png with Read and looked at it. It is a grey-box storyboard with no numbers. There are four panels: a wide tier at the top, two panels side by side in the middle tier, and a wide tier at the bottom. Reading order, left to right and top to bottom: (1) Top panel. The balloon at upper left, with its tail pointing right to the 'meera' box, reads: 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.' The 'ravi' box to the right has no text, so it is a silent listener. (2) Middle-left panel. The balloon at upper left, with its tail pointing right to the 'ravi' box, reads: 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' Below it, a teal label box at the left edge reads 'WELBUK HEALTH / for patients'. I read it after the balloon. (3) Middle-right panel. The balloon at the top, with its tail pointing down to the 'meera' box, reads: 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' There is a 'ravi' marker dot at the far right edge, outside any face box. (4) Bottom panel. The rectangular caption across the top reads: 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' There are small 'anany' and 'meera' boxes at centre-left and a 'ravi' box at right. None of them has dialogue, so this is a silent closing beat.
pages.observation: The order is clear. There is only one text element per tier, apart from the teal label, so a reader cannot skip a reply. The statement, question and answer chain from panel 1 to panel 3 holds up: Meera's 'That's the idea.' directly answers Ravi's question. Tails go to the boxes I would expect: panel 1 to meera, panel 2 to ravi, panel 3 to meera. Ambiguities: (a) The teal 'WELBUK HEALTH / for patients' box in panel 2 sits flush against the panel's left border. It is unclear whether it is a sign in the scene, an app screen or a caption, and from the storyboard alone it could be read before the balloon. (b) In panel 3 the 'ravi' marker sits at x~970 with no face box, and its label runs past the panel and page edge ('ravi' is cut off). Whether Ravi is visible there is unclear. (c) In panel 4 there is no text tying the three small figures to the caption, so the meaning depends on the art. (d) The panel 1 tail tip reaches into the meera box area, and the panel 2 tail tip touches the ravi box edge. That is fine in a storyboard, but the final art should be checked for the tails touching faces. All text was legible.

pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-07.png with Read and looked at it. It is the lettered colour page with four panels. (1) Top panel, a clinic front desk. A woman with a braid in a blue kurta is on the left, smiling and pointing at a phone held by a bearded man in a green shirt with a shoulder bag. Patients wait in the background. The balloon at upper left, with its tail to the woman's face, reads: 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.' The man silently looks at his phone and smiles. (2) Middle-left panel. The bearded man faces right and holds up the phone, which shows an app with calendar and heart icons. The balloon at upper left, with a short tail toward his head, reads: 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' Below it, a teal box over the background at the left reads 'WELBUK HEALTH / for patients'. (3) Middle-right panel. The woman at the desk gestures with an open palm toward the man, who is partly visible at the right edge holding his phone. The balloon at the top, with its tail pointing down to her head, reads: 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' (4) Bottom panel, outside the clinic. A woman doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope and the woman in the blue kurta wave from the doorway. The bearded man walks away to the right and waves back. The caption across the top reads: 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' This panel is a silent farewell.
pages.observation: The natural order matches the layout: P1, then P2, then P3, then P4. With one balloon per panel, I found no skipped reply. The question in P2 is answered by 'That's the idea.' in P3. All text was legible. Concerns: (a) P1: the tail tip ends on the woman's cheek and hair beside her eye (about x360,y208), and the balloon's right edge almost touches her hair. The tail is clearly hers, but it touches her face and hair. (b) P2: the balloon's right edge (about x348) comes very close to the man's hair, and the short tail tip touches his hair and temple. (c) P2: the teal 'WELBUK HEALTH / for patients' box floats over the background monitor and waiting area. It is not attached to the phone or to a sign, so its role is unclear: caption, app name or wall sign. Its left edge sits on the panel border. It does not cover a face. (d) P3: the tail tip stops at or just touches the top of the woman's hair. The balloon's right end (about x958) runs very near the partly visible man's hair at the right edge, and may touch it. A reader could briefly wonder whether the balloon belongs to the man, but the tail and her open-palm gesture make the woman the speaker. (e) P4: the caption box's lower right corner (about x688,y1216) meets or nearly meets the man's raised waving hand. That hand is an important farewell gesture and should not be touched. (f) The doctor in P4 does not appear in P1 to P3 of this page. A first reader may not know who she is from this page alone. There is no text that names her.
